# hallpass_login_key_activation (Resource)

Activates a login key once it is installed: HallPass first test-logs-in to the server or git host (probe) and activates the key only if that works. Make it depend on whatever installs the key (for example a `github_repository_deploy_key`). The previously active key of the role keeps working for its overlap window, then retires. Destroying this resource does not deactivate the key; destroy the `hallpass_login_key` to revoke it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Activate once the key is installed: HallPass test-logs-in first and refuses to activate a key that does not work.
resource "hallpass_login_key_activation" "acme_push" {
  role_id      = hallpass_git_access_profile.acme_push.id
  login_key_id = hallpass_login_key.acme_push.id
  depends_on   = [github_repository_deploy_key.api, hallpass_host_key.github]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `login_key_id` (String) Login key ID (`cred_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `role_id` (String) Role or git access profile ID (`rol_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Activate without a successful test login. Only for hosts the gateway cannot reach yet.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The login key ID.
- `state` (String) Login key state (`active`, or `retiring` after a newer key was activated).
